programs.organisation: The Shri Ram School CCC (Alumni Podcast)

programs.title: UKMT Senior Mathematical Challenge 2026
programs.overview: 90 minutes, 25 multiple-choice questions (4 points for correct, -1 for wrong, 0 for blank). Top 66% of scorers receive bronze/silver/gold certificates; all others receive a Certificate of Participation. Top 1,000 eligible participants qualify for the British Mathematical Olympiad (BMO) Round 1. Registration fee: Rs 3,475.

programs.title: Hackcessible India 2026 (University of Sheffield)
programs.overview: An online Assistive Technology Innovation Challenge designed to inspire students to develop inclusive engineering solutions. Teams of 3–4 students conceptualise and present technological solutions to real-world challenges in assistive technology.

programs.title: Warwick and Manchester: Virtual UCAS Personal Statement Workshop
programs.overview: Brief introductions to University of Warwick and University of Manchester, an overview of applying to UK universities, the UCAS personal statement (common mistakes and practical tips), personal statement case studies, and a quiz.
programs.organisation: University of Warwick & University of Manchester

programs.title: Discover USC Admission Event
programs.overview: A public information session about the University of Southern California (USC). Students and parents are welcome to register.

programs.title: Trust, Cooperation, and Education: A Framework for Economic Development (Indiana University Bloomington)
programs.overview: Engage with Indiana University faculty and explore how trust, cooperation, and education shape economic development through discussions and interactive sessions. Free for all students; certificates provided to attendees. When registering, use counsellor's name 'Aarti Bhatia - TSRS'.

programs.title: Singapore Management University Undergraduate Info Sessions 2026
programs.overview: All about Singapore Management University (SMU); an opportunity to engage with an alum and gain tips on how to ace your admissions interview.

programs.title: Conversations Over Coffee: A Special Edition for Students (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)
programs.overview: Explore opportunities at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore and learn more about studying in Italy — from Medicine and Surgery to Food Production Management, UCSC offers a wide range of English-taught programmes. Each student may be accompanied by one parent/guardian.
